notes.title: Teenage Blob turns 3!
notes.notes:
Guess which crowd-surfing, sandwich-slinging, high-five-delivering blob just turned 3! Teenage Blob!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/f8c0bd11815d05f07d64bab2df77e5bd21e46d39.gif[/img]

It's absolutely wild that [b]this little punk game is already 3 years old[/b]! It feels like just yesterday that we were animating Blob's little butt pedaling around on his BMX, but here we are, 3 years later!

To celebrate this occasion we're running a blobtastic birthday sale! To mark it's 3rd anniversary, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/]Teenage Blob[/url] (and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394980/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]Special Edition DLC[/url]) are both [b]discounted by 53%[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/3821048c4491f41c5f07345f251418eaa72903e1.jpg[/img]

We always knew Teenage Blob was an exceptionally weird offering. 3 years after it launched, people are still confused about the idea of a game band and a music band joining forces to create a split release. It's pretty safe to say that another 3 years from now, this will probably still be the case. We don't know if this kind of fringe release will ever find a huge audience, but there's 2 things we do know:
1) We truly believe that video games are the next forefront of punk
2) We will forever be grateful for every game punk that picked up and played Teenage Blob.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/9162766ff50eff54c6bcc60b2e491e5747487073.jpg[/img]

Teenage Blob's audience might have been small, but we were consistently overjoyed by the positive reception it got from people that did check it out. That continues to this day, as every once in a while a lovely new review appears to warm our hearts.

Thank you forever to every single person that got behind this strange little game, dressed their blob up in cute boots, fed sandwiches to stray dogs, and dived through the deepest blues. [b]You are all awesome and radical beyond words, and we're so grateful that folks like you exist.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/aeb52114676d4981951fec608e9467ada2b38caf.jpg[/img]

That's all from us for now! We're hard at work on our next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431250/Wrestling_With_Emotions_New_Kid_on_the_Block]Wrestling With Emotions 2[/url], and cramming a ton of Teenage Blob references into it! As a parting gift, here's a sneak peek of our Graffiti Creator minigame!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/2969e816b6e81303e2dbcdda30864a334b6ce0c0.png[/img]

[b]Thanks again to every teenage blob out there![/b] Love ya! Appreciate ya!
Team Lazerbeam
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/af97baef4560b18c3c0118b458315968ca415a92.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/1a0ca24aabb4786828744c57273f2590b349017b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Teenage Blob 2nd Birthday Blowout!
notes.notes:
[b]Happy birthday Teenage Blob! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/de04ae92848f80971e4c0bedb6db116e8248c1bb.gif[/img]
Born into the world 2 years ago today, this blobby baby was a labour of love between our two bands, The Superweaks and Team Lazerbeam. We had so much fun crafting the songs and games that make up this unique, playable split-record, and getting to finally share it with the world was a dream come true.

Today we celebrate the two year anniversary of that huge moment! Join us in marking the occasion with a huge Blob Birthday blowout sale! [b]For the next two weeks we're running a 50% sale [/b]on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/]Teenage Blob[/url] and it's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361240/Teenage_Blob_Paperperson__The_First_Single/]Special Edition DLC[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/f8c0bd11815d05f07d64bab2df77e5bd21e46d39.gif[/img]

We also wanna take this opportunity to reflect on some of the awesome stuff that we pulled off in releasing blob! Here's a list of 8 of our proudest moments!

[b]1) Performing Teenage Blob live![/b]
We were elated that we got to perform Teenage Blob live, with The Superweaks jamming the tunes, and Team Lazerbeam playing the games while they ripped through the songs. Here's our Blob performance for the wonderful Save and Sound Festival in 2021!
[previewyoutube=gyk8gyMy9u0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]2) Teenage Blob on vinyl![/b]
Our proudest merch moment was getting Teenage Blob pressed to vinyl! Shipping on a seafoam green record, housed in a sleeve designed to look like the case of a 16-bit cartridge, we think this is one of the all time coolest video game vinyls!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/81dce1feacab2ed22b15cb0caeb55a14ab37a9ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/9162766ff50eff54c6bcc60b2e491e5747487073.jpg[/img]
[b]
3) Turning in-game merch into real world t-shirts![/b]
Straight from Teenage Blob's wardrobe, and the merch stand at the gig, we loved getting to turn 2 in-game shirts into actual t-shirts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/09c2213df3eccb270c126a62c409a6bd754c7d5a.jpg[/img]

[b]4) Pizza Punx Hot Sauce![/b]
In yet another (so far as we knew) first, Teenage Blob was the first video game in history that shipped with a hot sauce! Crafted by Evan Superweaks under his Weak Sauce label, with art by Ben Lazerbeam, Pizza Punx was taste sensation and the perfect edible companion to our uniquely interactive rock and roll experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/72e330bba9ec69523bbc301104c2282dea566451.jpg[/img]
[b]
5) Getting high fives from Scott![/b]
We were consistently overjoyed hearing how Teenage Blob struck a chord with radical people. A highlight was seeing Blob win over one of our favourite game devs, the lovely Scott Benson, creator of the phenomenal Night In The Woods! It was amazing to see Blob in Scott's Giant Bomb article "Scott Benson's Top 10 Games of 2020" and this tweet also made us have a little happy cry:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/6db919588777ff03e568e666c90c2628b1856c9b.jpg[/img]
[b]
7) New York Game Awards nomination![/b]
It was such an honour see Teenage Blob nominated for the "Best Music in a Game" at the 10th annual New Work Game Awards! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/bc1a6173363377238cc0ea0a714cbfa194e65e83.jpg[/img]

[b]8) Attracting kindred spirits and making a zine together![/b]
This project brought some absolutely lovely people into our lives! It was great making new buds through Blob, and even better that we some of them got involved in the blob zine, featuring contributions from some our most radical friends and chosen family!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/6e786709770d68939678d289ac3c108a095becba.gif[/img]

If you were part of The blob Mob, we wanna pass on our most heartfelt and sincere thanks for getting in on this magic! We'll forever be so grateful to everyone that picked up our weird little contribution to the worlds of punk rock and video games - your purchases, playthrough and reviews meant the world to us!

Or, are you reading this thinking you still need to get your blob on?! Well, there's never been a better time! [b]Celebrate Teenage Blob's Birthday Blowout[/b] and grab a massively discounted copy of the game today! Or, if you wanna test the waters, there's no reason not to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361240/Teenage_Blob_Paperperson__The_First_Single/][b]grab our free demo/ single Paperperson![/b][/url]

Thanks, love and high fives!
Team Lazerbeam & The Superweaks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/9ecfe8df15716dca5948274305d740cba88840b6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teen Blob's rad award nomination & 2020 GOTY lists!
notes.notes:
As people have been looking back on the best game releases of 2020, a bunch of rad folks have been including Teenage Blob in their lists! Here are a few highlights of cool people who joined the Blob Mob in 2020!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/9162766ff50eff54c6bcc60b2e491e5747487073.jpg[/img]

Teenage Blob is [url=https://nygamecritics.com/2021/01/05/nominees-all-nominees-for-the-10th-annual-new-york-game-awards/]one of 8 nominees in the [b]"Best Music In A Game"[/b][/url] category of the upcoming [b]New York Game Awards![/b] This is a massive honor, and it's totally mind blowing to see our little punk game listed alongside AAA smash hits like Final Fantasy 7 Remake, Spider-Man: Miles Morales and Animal Crossing! The award show happens on the 26th of this month, so be sure to tune in for the show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/bc1a6173363377238cc0ea0a714cbfa194e65e83.jpg[/img]


[b]Scott Benson[/b], creative titan behind Night in The Woods, and one of our personal heroes, just listed Blob in his [url=https://www.giantbomb.com/articles/scott-bensons-top-10-games-of-2020/1100-6094/][b]"Top 10 Games of 2020" list for Giant Bomb[/b][/url]! In our sub-genre of punk games that balance cute playfulness with total hear-felt sincerity, Night In the Woods is our Nevermind. We can't overstate how much this means to us.


The excellent [url=https://gamesindustryafrica.com/2020/12/18/gia-people-of-the-year/]Games Industry Africa recently put out a list of "People of The Year"[/url] and we're delighted to announce that Team Lazerbeam were listed under the "Teams of The Year" section! Again, we're in very good company, alongside an awesome selection of African game developers. What an honour!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/1dcc15ee7f38cdec4d6c0d4761bf5eab872842d0.jpg[/img]

German indie game magazine [url=https://welcometolastweek.de/2021/01/15/die-besten-indie-games-des-jahres-2020/]Welcome To Last Week put together a "Best Indie Games of 2020"[/url] list and guess who the spot for Best Soundtrack! To quote the (autotranslated) words of writer Benja Hiller "Teenage Blob is not only one of my all-time favorite games of the year, but also my absolute favorite album of the year." How cool?!

New York game connoisseurs[url=https://www.sixoneindie.com/read/indie-celebration-2020] Six One Indie put together a 2020 Indie Celebration,[/url] sharing their favourite games of the year. We were overjoyed to be the top pick of the lovely Mike Towndrow saying "What Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks have accomplished with this title is truly outstanding. Teenage Blob is groundbreaking experience; the birth of a new medium" concluding "I fell in love with a Blob at the rock show, and I guarantee you will as well." Mike also wrote a super in depth article about what Teenage Blob meant to him, and did a rad video hangout with Team Lazerbeam's art and words person Ben! [url=https://www.sixoneindie.com/read/teenage-blob-amp-the-importance-of-live-music]Check it out here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/773a30eeef71c560362db19c0961a0d34e34fea3.jpg[/img]

And finally, over on The Avocado, we were stoked to be named [url=https://the-avocado.org/2020/12/16/new-game-releases-2020-buyers-guide-part-2/][b]"Hidden Gem of August"[/b] in Andy Tuttle's incredibly detailed breakdown of 2020's game releases![/url] "Underneath this simple premise, however, is a touching story of self identity and tragic loss, with the final song in the game giving me more chills, and tears, than I can remember any other game this year giving me".

Have we missed anything? Know of any other cool spots where Teenage Blob showed up? Let us know!

Thanks so much to every single person who helped spread the word about Teenage Blob in 2020! We've been so consisntently blow away by the support that it recieved in 2020, and hope it will continue to put smiles on new faces in 2021!

Love and high-fives
Team Lazerbeam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/aa2bd262e6293e109528e3b3a311de76cb32d3a8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teenage Blob "Extended Play" update out now!
notes.notes:
Team Lazerbeam and The Sperweaks are massively stoked to announce the release of Teenage Blob's "Extended Play" update! 

The first major update to our colourful art punk adventure, Extended Play is crammed full of new features and improvements!

[b]New Game Plus! [/b]
Unlocked after completing your first playthrough, New Game Plus significantly expands on the original Teenage Blob experience. Players can now play games in any order, and repeat play  individual tracks to their heart’s content.     

[b]Live Mode[/b]
Play along to a live version of Teenage Blob’s soundtrack! With recordings from their iconic “Live at A MAZE 2020” performance, the live versions of Teenage Blob’s 6 games let you ride, skate and riff along with The Superweaks as they tear things apart!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/7f8da3dbd1cdcf65e86cafc88e5d23e031086fee.gif[/img]
[b]Zine reader: [/b]
A special treat for owners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15850/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]Teenage Blob Special Edition[/url], this one lets you read your zine from the game’s main menu!  

[b]Hand crafted localization![/b]
More than one hundred new assets have been hand-crafted to give all players the ultimate Teenage Blob experience! Witness our handmade art in Japanese, Russian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Spanish and French!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/4470ee2fcc8cef88f0031f6106325df62a2063b3.gif[/img]

[b]Dozens of improvements and bug fixes: [/b]
Experience a refined-blob-economy! Enjoy fully functional achievements and look back on your victories with our in game achievement viewer! Skate through the reworked streets of Capeadelphia! Shred along with tighter directions on Guitar Zero! Marvel at Extended Play's multiple quality of life improvements!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/83227fecb76f75c16012af65203501f9b8ff24de.jpg[/img]
There's more to discover in game, so make your weekend more radical and give Teenage Blob: Expanded a spin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/aeb52114676d4981951fec608e9467ada2b38caf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teenage Blob is out!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone: [b]Teenage Blob is out![/b] After 3+ years of blob, sweat and tears, our colorful art-punk adventure has finally been released! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/]download the split right now[/url], relive the magic of going to a gig, and get in on what has to be one of the weirdest creations to ever hit Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/84631c39fd4e8ce087e26263304cc60d8e2f2a81.jpg[/img]

An unprecedented music/ game split is bound to confuse some people, but we’ve been massively encouraged by how well Teenage Blob has been received by both press and players. A bunch of cool videos and reviews have been created. There are too many highlights to name them all, but here are a couple of our favorite articles:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.hyperlightup.com/teenage-blob-review/]9.5/10 review on  Hyper Light Up![/url] “If this ain’t a 30 minutes indie masterpiece, then I do not know what else qualifies as one”
[*][url=https://www.pcgamer.com/if-you-miss-live-music-teenage-blob-is-a-pc-game-punk-album-that-captures-the-spirit-of-the-show/]"Play This” feature on PC Gamer![/url] "Like a bunch of late night pizza box doodles come to life, an interactive music visualizer and virtual mosh pit for the socially-distanced crowd desperately missing live music"
[*] [url=https://www.indiegamewebsite.com/2020/08/13/teenage-blob-review/]9/10 on Indie Game Website![/url] "It’s cute. It’s heartwarming. It’s a blast back to the days when you still had the energy and hormones to run around town.”
[/list]

There’s heaps more - far too much to cram into one blob blog! Sufice to say, it's been incredible seeing the split striking a chord with people all over The World! We felt so inspired, that we even included some of blob glowing press coverage in our brand new launch trailer. What else could we do when Kotaku called teenage blob "weird as f#$@*"?! (Warning: this trailer is loud!)

[previewyoutube=3yJxmYrsrR0;full][/previewyoutube]

Along with the main split, we’re also very happy to have[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15850/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/] launched the Teenage Blob Special Edition![/url] The SE features a 24 page zine, live versions of all Teenage Blob songs and a pack of wallpapers. If you’d like to show us some extra love (and bag a bunch of sweet blob treats) then the special edition is for you! If you already have a Standard Edition, you can also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394980/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]upgrade to Special Edition for a few bucks![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/b390303f77317069af0481a2b3de438a370b816c.png[/img]

Thank you so much to everyone who’s supported and encouraged us over the years that we’ve spent making Teenage Blob. We’re so grateful for everyone that’s played a part in helping make our blobby dreams a reality!

[b]  Love and high-fives!
 Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks
[/b]

notes.title: Teenage Blob burst onto Steam on 13 Aug!
notes.notes:
We're beyond stoked to share the release date for our colourful art-punk adventure, Teenage Blob! The hybrid game/ album split-release will burst onto Steam on the 13th of August 2020!

After 4+ years of development it feels totally surreal to be so close to finally being able to share our blobby baby with The World! notes.title: Teenage Blob: To Cut a Short Story Short
notes.notes:
It's fast! It's loud! It's weird as hell! Teenage Blob is not your average video game. A hybrid split release from Cape Town "game-band" [url=https://www.teamlazerbeam.com/]Team Lazerbeam[/url] and Philly "music-band" [url=https://thesuperweaks.bandcamp.com/]The Superweaks[/url], Teenage Blob is a truly unique beast. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/b8e0a08a0efd27bb6de3afb3c975aefe64e2b4db.gif[/img]

As the creators of this bizarre multimedia mutant, we think it's novelty is super exciting, but we know that it's raises a lot of questions. How the heck does this thing play? What're each of the tracks about? What kind of weirdos would make something like this? We're here to answer these questions, and offering future blobs a glimpse of what they can expect from Teenage Blob!

[previewyoutube=fUFaNIL4e_4;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]
Who the heck are you folks?![/b][/u]

We're a group of friends from opposite ends of the world! From our respective cities, we're a pair of bands that live to make art that's immediate, accessible and fun while being deeply heartfelt and personal at the same time.

[b]Hi, from Team Lazerbeam! [/b]

Out of Cape Town, South Africa! We’re a 3-piece game-band that create short, weird, cute games. Our past releases include the underground hits Wrestling With Emotions and Snow Cones 1 & 2. We've spent the past 5 years making lovingly crafted, experiences that bring joy & subvert expectations.

[b]Meet our besties, The Superweaks![/b]

From Philladelphia USA, The Superweaks are a shapeshifting supergroup, led by the songwriting, producing, hard-rocking polymaths Chris Baglivo & Evan Bernard. Touring & recording with a rotating cast of friends from other bands, the power-pop power-duo, write sweet songs about sad stuff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/e60482e92ed76741848cdfc9e3e7d281cc7fcf69.gif[/img]

[u][b]What's a Split Album?[/b][/u]

The split album is a long running DIY indie/punk tradition. It’s a collaborative release featuring songs by two or more bands. Typically each band takes a side of the record/tape, although some splits have seen bands alternating between tracks, remixing/ covering each other’s songs, or even joining forces to record new ones.
[u][b]
How Does Teenage Blob Work?[/b][/u]

As a hybrid game/ music release, picking up Teenage Blob gets you a collection of 6 songs, and 6 games. The songs come as individual high quality audio files, and the games are wrapped up into a larger meta-game, creating a single, non-linear, playable experience. Each “track” in Teenage Blob is a series of genre-hopping mini-games, perfectly timed to their corresponding song! All six of the tracks combined tell a single story of bands, butts and bootleg battle toads!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/c2e2f6def36b806c56d0ce2b69e00088f8cbbcb3.gif[/img]

[u][b]What Does it Play Like?[/b][/u]

Teenage Blob presents players with something truly unique; drawing influence from a wide spread of video game classics, and channeling them into an noisy fun adventure that's impossible to pin down. From start to finish you'll be presented with radically different mechanics and systems, designed to encourage player expression, and provide a steady stream of opportunities for righteous wins or hilarious mishaps.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/52b4e561fd90d31ea8f9179758055f69ebdb8e62.gif[/img]

Regardless of the genres that each track pays homage to, every moment of Teenage Blob is loud, fast and presented with a hand-crafted sense of joy, that we find far too rare in most video games.

[u][b]This sounds cool as heck! How can I get involved?![/b][/u]

We're so happy you asked - it's an exciting time to be a blob fan and there's a bunch you can do!

1) Play our 1 track demo for Paperperson, exclusively available over Steam Games Festival!
2) Wishlist Teenage Blob (we appreciate this more than you'll know!)
3) Tune into [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1096060/view/2237673324857717624]Thursday's AMA session[/url] and hang out with us! (Set a reminder right here!)
4) Watch us goofing off in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1096060/view/2237673324856382906]Saturday's Teenage Blob Variety Show![/url] (Set a reminder for this too!)
5) [url=https://discord.com/invite/yWQAXr7]Add our Discord[/url] and join our journey towards launching this blobby baby!
6) Sign up to our beta program, AKA Best Blobs! (Available over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/yWQAXr7]our Discord[/url] too!)
7) Spread the word! A music/game split-record about amorphous teen punx is obviously a pretty damn niche offering. It's certainly not everyone's cup of tea, but we know that for the right people this split will be an absolute joy to discover! if you know of some cool game punx that would be stoked on this kinda weirdness, please let them know about Teenage Blob! You'll make your friend's day, and ours at the same time!

Thanks so much for your interest in this bizarre game baby! We hope you'll check out the 1-track demo, and that you'll have a mountain of fun ripping up the suburban sidewalks of Paperperson!

Love and high-fives,
Team Lazerbeam & The Superweaks

notes.title: Our Blobby Cat is Out of the Bag! - Teenage Blob Dev Log 01!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/e60482e92ed76741848cdfc9e3e7d281cc7fcf69.gif[/img]
Our blobby cat is out of the bag! I can't tell you all how good it feels to have finally announced the next Team Lazerbeam release, Teenage Blob! We spent three years working on this project in secret, and we're so happy to finally have announced the game to The World and made the itch page public.

So, what is Teenage Blob? You can head over to[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/] the store page[/url] for some more detailed info, but in short, Teenage Blob is the The World's first game/music split release! It's a collection of 6 new games from [url=https://www.teamlazerbeam.com/]Team Lazerbeam[/url] and 6 new songs from [url=https://thesuperweaks.bandcamp.com/]The Superweaks[/url], all wrapped up together into a single interactive tale of bands, butts and bootleg battletoadz! Confused about how that would work? Maybe our announcement trailer can help clear things up!
[previewyoutube=cbykmqdbJOM;full][/previewyoutube]
Unveiling this weird concept has been an interesting experience. We were expecting a lot head scratching and confusion (which has happened for sure) but were very pleasantly surprised to discover the concept clicking with a lot of people! Despite this being the first time a game band and music band have joined forces in this way,it seems like there's something about the collaboration that  just makes sense to people. And, in the case of people that aren't too interested in the team-up nature of the project, the larger story of Teenage Blob really seems to be striking a chord! Some people seem to love the idea of a game that follows a blobby teen on quest to see their favourite band live. This really comes across in some awesomely insightful and enthusiastic articles that people have written about Blob's reveal (for good examples see what the lovely people at [url=https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbigbossbattle.com%2Fteenage-blob-is-a-unique-colorful-nostalgic-game%2F%3Ffbclid%3DIwAR1K_y7T2wVlDthnlXo1y-tVF5G7UIZJR_EsMLF0RcY0EQKzxdhrQdO2pAI&h=AT2z21xruFMzoTE_UNwsCJUlSk3a5jAraIQ4GHj3QmmH6a8zDrb-Cr_7UF0KiZmQ3u4Poc7jjfWv-uK4L-hRLfgPDHcjW2X-N6xIwBJc6WbV6v8aD_9Y4FK4zG77i0heO5RaBDuqa5YS0-0z2A7fNQoexUlGze0p4orh_RbwiezUHvOMqz_cU8RTPpKNTPUR8gAEiTDQGhR6otLFRyysqu4QTzRbOeM0Dt0y2b4Kq3kHK6_bu0i4GmD1MpMrOvG_OnCVjdAMI_72v3EdRsqOUaqgvFyXCW2U6g8vDnszNY0StW12hJhxQfZS2XnkD4As60DWXeQyTMKBnFsPSHD0pL5_-i3RycopkhwuZWVNYlY_Jk_h6SQWUq_8R5HBJEH42syas58TDXDhvzjCu7WngCF-HJ3u3OnrnY7yKneywmoavKD6d32DVWBf4S4xsLtLTDFM41Ao3UPrqb5CGPTI46QgMdpCPHOpQ9mRd5WKC7Eg6VwtH6L2gIFdh65XAfEBflnloTIvGlAdbPA4K77RGsx9e7C9mam2XZ4PhdpmSBZXZnoTjc5lnsMbwcPeatJzsvCs736Mc_QFUBXY_ZQVesfAudPjMmC4-MT6zMAE-wJLMPVt4xzbrIyVMP1Lj6yaM-V5P7Nw6dA]Big Boss Battle[/url] and [url=https://www.thegamer.com/teenage-blob-art-punk-half-game-half-music-album/]The Gamer[/url] and [url=https://indiegamesplus.com/2020/06/teenage-blob-helps-amorphous-teens-reach-rockin-concerts]Indie Games +[/url]) . notes.title: Teenage Blob: PMA AMA
notes.notes:
Teenage Blob, is The World's very first music/ game split release, and being such a new concept it seems to raise of lot of questions. What does a hybrid release like this play like? Where the heck did the concept come from? How did Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks go about bringing this crazy concept to life?

We're super excited to be hosting "PMA AMA" as a special event designed to answer all these questions, and any others that folks might have! Not only that, but over the time of this AMA session we're gonna be taking any kind of request that we can realistically satisfy over our stream!
